cells.value: The mundane astrology broken into reusable atoms: an actor (planet), a field (sign), an arena (house), a dialogue (aspect), a degree, a modifier. Each defined once, in our terms. The Assembler tab pulls the pieces for a real ingress so they can be mashed into the whole. Puzzle pieces, not paragraphs. Reframed from the natal method to the nation.
Whole Sign houses. Tropical. Geocentric. EVERY chart cast for Washington, D.C. Locked US natal: 2 July 1776, ~5:10pm LMT, Sagittarius rising.
The unit is the ingress, NOT the day
Mundane astrology is a nested hierarchy: the cardinal INGRESS sets the season -> the LUNATIONS inside it time the events -> ECLIPSES supercharge. A 'chart for today' has no standing. Work the ladder.

The master move. Trace EVERY planet up its dispositor chain (planet -> ruler of its sign -> that ruler's sign-ruler...) until it bottoms out in a final dispositor or a loop. That terminus is the chart's gravity-well: the one story every actor ultimately serves. Name the root, read everything as service to it.

A number throws away the thing that makes it astrology. And 'Mercury in fall in the 10th' is an ADDRESS, not a reading. Read MOTIVATION, not location: what does this actor want, how does it get it, what is its role in the whole story. Condition modifies the HOW, never the WHAT/WHY.

Every symbol carries light AND shadow by design. Reading only the shadow ('hollow, dissolving, cannot be trusted') is its own amputation. Hold both; let the rest of the chart decide which is called forth.

Read the actors as a cast that keeps its colors (blend like colors, do not average to gray). Dignity is the QUALITY of an actor's tools, not the SIZE of its role: Jupiter in fall can still command the scene. Prominence comes from angularity + tight aspects to the lights/ruler + dispositorship.

Sun = the executive. Moon = the political class (NOT the people). Mercury = the press. Venus = women/arts/diplomacy/currency. Mars = the military & the men. Jupiter = courts/corporations/the economy's barometer. Saturn = the establishment/bureaucracy. Uranus = revolution/technology. Neptune = propaganda/mass movements (leans malefic). Pluto = covert power/the masses-as-force.

The rising sign and its ruler ARE the people; give the angles pride of place — what touches the ASC can be released into the world. The MC is the government's public face. Mars ANGULAR is the classic war warning.

Read the no-aspect SILENCES too (what does not talk is signal). Neptune is almost always malefic here. Mars in the 7th under any condition can presage war. Saturn's North Node = escalation ('wars begin'); Neptune's North Node = resolution ('wars end').
Meaning over event; navigated, not predicted. The mercy is locating the ARC — where a hard season peaks and where it ends. Difficulty has a far edge. 'Suggests', never 'will'.
Round each placement UP (floor+1) to its degree-symbol. A private depth-layer: nuance that refines the read, never a headline. The degrees tell the story behind the structure.

As above, so below: the sky and the news rhyme; the chart does not push the events. The daily-resolution backtest came back null — this is a language for reading an era, archetypal not predictive. The lens amplifies; stay grounded in actual data.

This workbook is the SOURCE OF TRUTH for the ATOMS — the look-up facts (definitions, dignities, degree symbols, midpoint pairs, turned houses). It exists to stop definitional drift between sessions (e.g. 'Moon = the political class, NOT the people'). The METHOD and JUDGMENT — how to weight, take-it-to-the-root, both-poles, the cautions, worked readings — live in the PROSE notes (Reading the Charts — START HERE, the Master Reference, the study notes), and this workbook DEFERS to them on how to read. One home per fact: look-ups here, reasoning there. Never assemble a reading out of cell-values alone (the 'address trap').
ACTORS — the planets as mundane agents (who each one IS in the life of the nation)
Atomic actor definitions (canonical). Full god-stories: Barz — Gods and Planets. Read per START HERE.
The EXECUTIVE — whoever really runs the government (not the national 'ego'); the barometer of how the government fares.
To lead, hold authority, be the visible center of power.
Strong, respected leadership; the government fares well.
A weak, discredited, or floundering executive.
Watch combustion: any planet within 8 deg 30' is co-opted by the executive, used for its ends. Dignity + aspects show plainly how the government will fare.
Helios drives his four-horse chariot across the sky, seeing everything, and each night is carried back through the dark ocean to rise again. 'I am I'.
The POLITICAL CLASS — the fraction with an actual political voice (NOT 'the people'; that is the 1st house). Also the public mood, the common life, women, the food supply.
To voice the public, reflect and lead the national mood.
The political class still speaks for the country; responsive government.
Volatility; the class estranged from the people it claims to speak for.
When Moon and 1st-ruler harmonize, the class still speaks for the country; a run of hostile aspects = it has lost the plot. Fastest body — times the events.
Many goddesses in one cycle: Selene in the dark, Artemis hunting free, Persephone descending so the grain may grow, Hecate at the crossroads, Hera full.
The PRESS & national conversation: media, transport, trade documents, treaties-as-paper, the chattering classes.
To report, debate, carry the message and the goods.
Ideas drive events; clear communication; trade and transport flow.
The ideas on center stage are confused or dysfunctional; communication and transport break down.
Never far from the Sun, so easily combust (captured by the executive). Rules tools needing human skill — Uranus rules automation.
Born at dawn, by noon he built the lyre, by night he stole Apollo's cattle and drove them backward to erase the trail — the messenger between all worlds.
WOMEN & women's issues; the arts, culture, diplomacy, social peace; the currency's grace.
To value, make peace, bring contentment and beauty.
Contentment and prosperity; successful diplomacy; social peace.
Scandal, extravagance, women's concerns shoved aside, ugliness in public life.
The lesser benefic — eases whatever she touches; in hard aspect, indulgence and overspend.
From the foam of heaven's severed creative power Aphrodite rose; where she stepped ashore the earth blossomed. The wealth that grows more abundant in the giving.
The MILITARY, war, police, violent crime, political unrest; the men of the nation and the men's vote.
To fight, to force, to assert by arms.
The reformer: bad officials removed, real prosecutions, decisive hard change.
War, riot, accident, arson, bloodshed; force without direction.
Mars ANGULAR (1st/4th/7th/10th) is the classic war warning; Mars in the 7th under any condition can presage war.
The unloved son of Zeus and Hera, the brawler who fights for both sides and bellows like ten thousand men — redeemed only through Venus, his opposite.
The COURTS, the wealthy, every hierarchy that grows — corporations, judges, clergy, banks; the economy's barometer.
To expand, prosper, preside and bless.
Peace, order, profit; a generous, confident economy.
Stagnation and corruption — problems ignored while still small; inflation, hubris, legal overreach.
The Greater Benefic is NOT purely benefic — bigger is not always better; its shadow is cured by Saturn.
Raised in a cave on goat's milk, Zeus deposed old Kronos without repeating his crime — freed the prisoners, ended one-sidedness, gave every power its honour.
The ESTABLISHMENT & the bureaucracy; institutional inertia, austerity, the elder order; hard facts and the things that endure.
To restrain, enforce limit and consequence, make endure.
Stability and calm — prosperity through wise management, not growth.
Past behavior's unwanted consequences arrive; austerity, decay, scandal, loss of standing.
Negative Saturn brings more grief than almost any placement; useful, shows the limits, NOT to be feared.
Kronos cut Heaven from Earth and began measured time, then ruled in fear, swallowing his children — yet given Latium, the old tyrant taught the harvest.
REVOLUTION, technology, the people-as-individuals: democracy, countercultures — and the machines that run without us (automation, the internet).
To disrupt, free, break the old form open.
Constructive reform and national breakthrough; new tech as success.
Crises, failed reforms, sudden shocks, strikes, explosions, upheaval.
Mercury rules tools needing human skill; Uranus rules automation. Read WITH its containers, the Sun & Saturn.
The starry sky covered the Earth; the children came too many and too monstrous, so Uranus pushed them back into the dark — the creative excess we ourselves bury.
PROPAGANDA & mass movements, ideology, speculative bubbles, scandal, oil and the sea, the collective mood — unity from the divine to the mob.
To dissolve, enchant, merge the many into one feeling.
Rare, only unafflicted: genuine collective ideals, art and compassion at scale.
Almost always malefic here — deception, fog, scandal, bubbles, the mob, drift, contagion.
THE hardest-won rule: Neptune is almost always malefic in a mundane chart. Only completely unafflicted does he favor peace.
Three paces take Poseidon to his castle on the sea-floor; his trident raises the storm or lays the fog of forgetting. Heaven's lost power fell into HIS waters.
COVERT power, the masses-as-force: purgation, destruction-and-rebirth, the deep state, debt, the atom, what power does in the dark.
To purge, seize, transform from the root by force.
Necessary purgation; deep, real reform; the phoenix.
Coercion, terror, collapse, the underworld; catastrophe projected more than realized.
Handle with SKEPTICISM — Pluto invites projection more than any planet; many predicted catastrophes never came. Usually falls to the covert 12th.
Hades means 'the invisible': the eldest brother who walked the earth once, to seize Persephone — lord of the depth, and of the riches concealed in the ground.
The national WOUND that will not fully heal — and the outsider/maverick who works from it.
To expose and tend the wound that cannot be cured.
The wounded-healer register: hard-won repair, injury made into strength.
Scapegoating, festering grievance, the wound weaponized.
A minor body; use lightly. Healed, not cured.
The wounded centaur-healer, immortal yet pierced by an incurable wound, who teaches and tends from the injury he cannot cure himself.
The collective's GROWTH EDGE — where the era is drawing the nation; eclipses here set the curriculum.
To take in the unfamiliar the age demands.
Forcing it, or bypassing the lesson.
Saturn's NN = the escalation point ('wars begin here'); Neptune's NN = the resolution point ('wars end here'). A guidance axis, not rigid fate.
The Dragon's Head — the direction the cycle pulls toward; where the eclipses set the era's lesson.
The collective's OLD HABIT — what the nation reaches for under stress and must spend down; eclipses here audit the past.
To fall back on the mastered, familiar reflex.
A real earned competence to lean on.
Hiding in the comfortable rut; repeating the past.
The discharge point — what drains away. Read as the pair to the North Node.
The Dragon's Tail — the mastered, familiar reflex the cycle pours out and must spend down.

Rash war, impulse, the unprovoked strike.

Same declination, same hemisphere = a conjunction-like linkage. Read on EVERY chart; catches links with no ecliptic aspect.

★ MINOR / HARMONIC ASPECTS – the NUMBER that divides the circle IS the meaning (Addey). Orb shrinks with the harmonic: base ~12–15° ÷ harmonic # (trine 4–5°, square 3–4°, quintile 3°, septile 2°…). Minors get FULL weight at TIGHT orbs (Morrison). Octave doctrine (Hand): sextile = octave of trine; opp/square/45/22.5 = octaves of the conjunction. Declination parallels = the PARAN family, not zodiacal aspects – read on every chart; an eclipse (aspect + parallel) hits hardest.

Trines+sextiles+oppositions — a stable, self-justifying structure; capable, can be smug.

Low-grade chronic friction — nagging, unresolved adjustment.
A questing, restless figure — the nation looking for its footing.

A commanding figure — one theme rules the period.
A building figure — sustained constructive effort.

A cushioning figure — absorbs shock, softens a hard contact.

The 3 colours (read the FIGURE as one unit): RED (square+opposition) = conflict/the work; BLUE (trine+sextile) = ease/flow; GREEN (quincunx+semisextile) = adjustment/seeking. Order of authority: the actors FIRST, then the Huber figure, then the secondary layers (midpoints, Sabian).
WAXING vs WANING — Tierney's registers (where in the cycle the aspect sits)
Quick reference. Full method: Huber / Tierney.
Seed of the whole cycle (Aries / 1st / Mars flavour): the two functions fuse and assert as one. Begins the cycle; no upper/lower split.
LOWER (30°, Taurus / 2nd): emergent, resourceful first stirring of the new.
UPPER (330°, Pisces / 12th): release, dissolve, let the cycle go.
LOWER (60°, Gemini / 3rd): curious opportunity, learning, trying it out.
UPPER (300°, Aquarius / 11th): apply it socially, to the group and to goals.
LOWER (90°, Cancer / 4th / Moon): subconscious insecurity, root vulnerability; acting from the gut.
UPPER (270°, Capricorn / 10th / Saturn): social responsibility, guilt, authority pressure; acting for the world.
LOWER (120°, Leo / 5th): creative, self-expressive enjoyment of the gift.
UPPER (240°, Sagittarius / 9th): philosophical, shared, taught wisdom.
LOWER (150°, Virgo / 6th): adjustment through work, health, daily refinement.
UPPER (210°, Scorpio / 8th): adjustment through crisis, merger, the shared and taboo.
The TURN (Libra / 7th): full awareness through the Other; the pivot from waxing (formative) to waning (evaluative).

An aspect reads differently by WAXING (applying / Moon ahead of Sun) vs WANING. Mundane: waxing = the new order being BUILT (instinctive, rising); waning = the established order being SPENT (conscious, distributing). Pairs with the lunation phases.
